verdict.rationale: Composio's Triggers docs say that events from connected apps, such as a new Slack message, a GitHub commit or an incoming email, arrive as structured payloads. Composio POSTs every trigger event to a webhook URL registered once per project, and each event is signed so it can be verified. That covers the core of subscribing to events via webhooks. Missing for 10: details on how to enable or subscribe to specific triggers per user or connection, delivery and retry guarantees, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
